line: She know if I’m anywhere I got my Smith & Wesson I’m in my city everywhere from Lakeshore to Western
vault_lines: She know if I'm anywhere I got my Smith & Wesson
meaning:
Smith & Wesson is one of the largest manufacturers of firearms in the United States.

“Lakeshore” Drive is a 15 milenlong expressway that runs parallel to the shoreline of Lake Michigan in Chicago. “Western” is in reference to another famous Chicago street, Western Avenue, which is the longest continuous street in Chicago, running over 188 blocks and 25.5 miles.

By referencing two Chicago streets that are  geographically on opposite sides of the city, G Herbo is trying to convey to his lady friend that his presence in Chicago is ubiquitous, while also noting that you’ll never catch him in his city without his Smith & Wesson firearm.
